_comment: Claude Code / Cursor. Copy to .mcp.json in the repo you want to USE the server from, then replace the two ALL-CAPS placeholders. MCP_CLONE is where you cloned local_hex_mcp; YOUR_PROJECT is the repo you are editing. DATABASE_PATH is deliberately absent: it defaults to <MCP_CLONE>/priv/mcp.db, which is also what 'mix setup' migrates, so one shared database needs no configuration at all. See README 'AI Code Assistant Configuration'.
